thread:
Maria Alvarez: Quick sync — MistralWorks reserved pool goes live Thurs 09:00 PT. Final checklist: quota confirmation, autoscale policy, smoke load test window, and rollback triggers. Who's on call?
Tom Chen: I'm on call for infra. Can we confirm committed qps and burst capacity?
A.J. Patel: Contract shows 600 qps steady, 1.8k burst for 15m. We should reserve 700 steady to be safe.
Leah Brooks: Recommend warmup run 2 hours before go-live, then a 30m smoke at target qps. Also run KV cache priming.
Kevin O'Neal: +1 on cache priming. Suggest priming script: `python tools/prime_kv.py --customer mistralworks --threads 32 --duration 45m`
Maria Alvarez: Nice. For autoscale, ops asks for thresholds. Tom, can you propose?
Tom Chen: Proposed policy: `min=6 pods, target_cpu=65%, scale_up_step=2, cooldown=120s, max=24 pods` Also enable burst-tier fallback to shared-hosted if pool exhausted.
A.J. Patel: Can we add token-rate gating at 2k/sec per account for safety? If fallback triggers, route 10% of requests to best-effort queue for 10m then ramp.
Leah Brooks: Test plan: 08:00 PT warmup (priming), 08:30–09:00 smoke at 700 qps, 09:00–10:00 progressive ramp 700->1.8k in 15m steps. Monitor 95p latency, error-rate, and kv hit rate.
Kevin O'Neal: I'll run the smoke harness. Command: `loadtest --target 700 --duration 30m --prom-url https://prom.redwood.internal --labels team=cs customer=mistralworks`
Maria Alvarez: Rollback criteria: errors >1% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency >1.2s for 3m => abort and shift traffic to hosted fallback.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: reserved-pool/mistralworks v1.12 -> 6 pods. CI passes.
Tom Chen: Noted. I'll validate autoscaler config post-deploy and tag in this thread.
A.J. Patel: I'll notify customer enablement and schedule the landing workshop immediately after go-live.
Leah Brooks: Also capture a quick eval prompt set for quality monitoring during ramp. I can prepare 20 prompts.
Maria Alvarez: Perfect. Kevin/Tom coordinate priming timing with the deploy. Call if >5% errors during priming.
Kevin O'Neal: Running priming now (expected 45m). Logs: `priming: 12% keys warmed, ETA 32m`
Tom Chen: Autoscaler config checked and applied. min=6 max=24, policy attached.
Kevin O'Neal: Priming complete. Starting smoke run at 08:30 PT.
Kevin O'Neal: Smoke run result: avg latency 320ms, p95 780ms, errors 0.08%. KV hit 89%.
Maria Alvarez: Great. Proceed to progressive ramp at 09:00. Leah will post prompt eval.
Leah Brooks: Prompt eval posted: initial batch looks green. Small degeneration at high-length tokens — flagging to research.
A.J. Patel: Customer notified. They are ready to cutover at 09:15 if all metrics hold.
Tom Chen: At 09:10 autoscaler scaled to 12 pods, traffic steady. No errors.
Kevin O'Neal: Ramp hit 1.8k qps at 09:35. p95 1.05s, errors 0.9% (transient), KV hit 85%.
Maria Alvarez: We're within SLA thresholds. Keep monitoring for 30m, then mark as green.
A.J. Patel: Scheduling renewal touchpoint next week to capture initial usage patterns.
Tom Chen: Leaving notes in the runbook: `mistralworks/1975012345/runbook.md` and linking autoscaler snapshot.
Maria Alvarez: Thanks team. Postmortem items: investigate p95 bump at highest qps and prompt degeneration. Otherwise great job :rocket:
